question: For what fivefold purposes is image-sacrifice done in initiation and installation?
premises: in initiation and installation, for convention-purification, for desire-purpose, that image-sacrifice is fivefold to be done
inference: Image-rite serves initiation, installation, purification, desire — fivefold.
plain_english: In initiation and installation, for conventions purification, for desire-purpose, that image-sacrifice fivefold is to be done.
